versions.changelog: Add 8-language usage documentation (zh-CN, zh-TW, en, ja, ko, ru, es, fr)

Initial release of li-bid-document-maker

- Automatically converts Chinese tender documents (PDF/Word) into structured, score-oriented bid response documents.
- Features a 6-stage workflow: file parsing, strategy analysis, outline generation, section writing, quality check, and PDCA improvement.
- Aligns with standard Chinese bid document templates and compliance requirements.
- Supports user interaction at outline confirmation; quality and compliance checks are automated.
- Compatible across Windows, macOS, and Ubuntu platforms; can be integrated into multiple agents.
